doc: Cloud objects of a patch: mask = patch > 0.5 (strict), scipy.ndimage.label with its default structure, 4-CONNECTIVITY (edge neighbours only: two texels that touch diagonally are two objects; no wraparound), area = texel count * patch_px_km^2 (77.0252 km^2 per texel); returns (share of the cloudy area held by objects larger than 1e5 km^2, median object area in km^2), and (0.0, 0.0) when there is no object. No object (every value exactly 0.5, and the mask is strict): the (0.0, 0.0) branch.
